content.short: DePay enables Web3 payments for merchants and developers powered by DeFi.
content.description: DePay delivers a DeFi- and Web3-based payment infrastructure for blockchain-based transactions. It automatically converts tokens at the moment of payment, providing merchants with flexibility and a smoother checkout experience. Merchants and developers can receive payments in real time, enabling instant cash flow and faster settlement. By leveraging DeFi, DePay broadens the range of digital assets that can be accepted, allowing merchants to support a wider set of tokens across different networks and payment scenarios.
content.meta: DePay provides DeFi and Web3 payment infrastructure for blockchain-based payments. Discover DePay and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
